purpose: Research and applicability checklist; not an assertion every permit is required.
completion_rules: Review applicability separately for every role; unknown is unresolved.
The same office can fulfill multiple roles only with evidence for each responsibility.
County membership alone does not prove county office responsibility for a city or township.
Shared or third-party inspection providers require explicit delegation and service-area evidence.
A generic electrical authority review does not automatically establish issuance or inspection responsibility.
A not-applicable conclusion requires supporting evidence and review; no invented office or approval.
Downloaded forms and official online submission links must be retained when available.
